scope: Read complete Japanese premises/exchanges and all12 target sentence/task sets. Metadata/native/device approval excluded.
reviewCriteria: Apparent perspective size versus actual tree size; compare viewpoints while remaining on the path.
Reconstruction versus original surviving buildings; distinguish speculative claims from the board and retain evidence for dates.
Keep the window out of the photographic frame rather than physically removing it; preserve privacy and entrance access.
Unconfirmed medical preparation: ask the responsible staff, do not invent fasting instructions; contact family only after explanation.
